1 | Cooked yellow squash or ... 

Let me reconsider: a round yellow piece with golden skin, pale cream interior, dense fibrous center, dome shape, roughly 4 cm diameter, no sauce. Likely candidates: golden beet (no, interior would be colored), yellow potato round/dumpling, cornbread muffin/corn cake (no, crumb), egg-based item like a baked egg tart, or a steamed bun. A cut yellow-skinned round with pale interior and dense center fits a boiled/steamed yellow potato or a yellow turnip. A small roasted potato or yellow pepper... Most likely: a small cooked yellow potato (e.g., Yukon Gold, golden skin, pale cream flesh, dense center).
